name: kissmypost
description: Reddit analytics and audience research for Claude, with KissMyPost data. Find the subreddits where a topic is discussed and see each one's size, 12-month growth and audience (age, gender, shared interests), the best day and hour to post, similar communities and posting rules. Track how often Reddit mentions or links to a brand, product or website. Five skills: subreddit finder, audience research, best time to post, brand mentions and a Reddit marketing plan. Read-only.
